identity.name: Uncommon Service Creation via sc.exe for Persistence
identity.summary: An attacker creates a malicious service using sc.exe to establish persistence on a Windows endpoint. Cortex should detect the creation of an unusual service via the Windows Service Control Manager.
identity.description: An attacker creates a malicious service using sc.exe to establish persistence on a Windows endpoint. Cortex should detect the creation of an unusual service via the Windows Service Control Manager.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

payload.code:
cd C:\temp
sc create MyService binPath= "C:\temp\malware.exe" start= auto
sc description MyService "This is a fake service description"
sc config MyService binPath= "C:\temp\malware.exe"

expected_artifacts.description: Service Control Manager process spawning sc.exe with service creation args

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Service Create/Config
biocs.description: Detection of a process creating or configuring a Windows service not typically seen in normal operations
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'services.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'create' or action_command_line contains 'config'
| filter action_command_line contains 'MyService'

abiocs.name: Uncommon Service Creation Behavior
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation from typical service creation patterns, identified via ML on service creation events
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'services.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'create' or action_command_line contains 'config'
| filter action_command_line contains 'MyService'
| filter not action_command_line contains 'binPath'
abiocs.causality_anchor: sc.exe process creation with service config args
